The proposed subdivision is located along an existing improved pub lic road and involves no opening, widening, or extension of any street or road. B. No more than five (5) lots are involved after the original parcel has been subdivided. C. The proposed subdivision is not contrary to applicable Subdivision Regulations, Design Criteria, Construction Standards and Drawings, or Zoning Code. D.
